description: Land Acquisition - No. 47, Poonewa,  Medawachchiya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific lands/servitudes for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels including lot numbers, land names, persons who enjoyed the land, permit/grant numbers, extents, and boundary information. This falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
